name: Yanina Shkel
one_sentence_summary: Yanina Shkel is an EPFL Assistant Professor at the Mathematics of Information Laboratory whose research focuses on the theoretical foundations of data privacy (differential privacy, maximal leakage), information-theoretic secrecy, minimum entropy couplings, and functional representations.
matrix_summary: Yanina Shkel and PhD student Anuj Kumar Yadav have posted a substantial new preprint, "Couplings and Entropic Inequalities on the Majorization Lattice" (Oct 2026), which extends their earlier work on Rényi entropy geometry to establish coupling-based entropic inequalities, supermodularity results, and a polynomial-time minimum entropy coupling algorithm with applications to optimal transport and econometrics.
